instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully local AI Motion Graphics & SaaS Video Generator suite using React JS (.js), Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components. Features include: Sequential Multi-Agent Pipeline (Orchestrator, Planner, Copywriter, Designer, Director, Critic) streaming live via SSE/polling from Ollama (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:3b); Interactive Agent Timeline panel with status, expandable output, elapsed time, and manual rerun/edit; Remotion-style timeline player with playback, scrub, aspect ratio switcher (16:9 & 9:16); Scene Editor & Reorder (templates: TextReveal, Flowchart, SocialMockup, SearchBar, DeviceMockup, CallToAction); MP4 export simulation/rendering pipeline; Project persistence in SQLite (or local storage fallback); Ollama Health Check component with quick-fix command; Settings modal for per-agent models & toggles; Seed example projects. All elements must include appropriate data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Share guidelines for .js files not .tsx files.
